component.name: WhatsApp for COSMIC
component.summary: Unofficial native WhatsApp client for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: A native Rust client built with libcosmic. It links to your phone as a WhatsApp linked device by scanning a QR code, and supports chats and groups, replies, reactions, emoji, images, stickers, GIFs, voice messages, documents, voice calls, status updates, search and desktop notifications.
Your message history and session keys are stored in SQLCipher-encrypted databases. The encryption key lives in your desktop keyring, so a copied database file cannot be read without it.

This is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. Using unofficial clients may violate the WhatsApp Terms of Service and could lead to your account being banned.

New look (Tokyo Night by default, no title bar, chat filters), an emoji panel, GIF search and in-place GIF playback, voice message recording, search within a chat, contact details, online and last seen, pinned and favourite chats, notification volume and custom notification sounds, and better syncing of what you read on your phone.
